svg.title: A year, in motion — contribution gallery
svg.desc: Contribution graph ambient animation — Tide → Constellation → Pathfinder → Pong → Heartbeat → Code Rain → Plasma → Life → Sort, one scene every 15 seconds. 364 active days. Reduced motion shows the original contribution graph.

text.tspan: One long swell rolling from the first week to the last
The busiest days, joined into a star chart
Breadth-first search through a maze, from the first day to the latest
The year plays itself at Pong
A steady pulse, traced week by week like a bedside monitor
Green glyph streams, each falling at its own pace
Demoscene palette cycling, rolling across the year
Conway's Game of Life, seeded by the days you showed up
Weeks ranked by activity, sorted in parallel passes
